title: Film Reel Nightmare
description: A distressed woman in a pink and multicolored dress stands in an ornate room filled with framed paintings, holding a large film reel while film strip unwinds from her body and neck. A ghostly screaming face emerges from her chest as a beam of light from a tall arched window illuminates floating film particles and a 'FOLLOW ALONG' sign outside.
prompt: A surreal painting of a terrified woman with brown hair wearing a pink dress with yellow and blue sleeves, standing in a cluttered ornate room with many framed paintings on the walls. She holds a large film reel as film strip unwinds from her torso revealing a screaming ghostly face emerging from her chest. A strong beam of light shines through a tall arched window showing a dark castle silhouette and the words FOLLOW ALONG in the night sky, with film particles floating in the air.
